name: Mercury
description: Check your balance, download statements, search/analyze/graph transactions, and understand Cards directly from Claude. Mercury brings your finances into your AI tools

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mercury to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mercury to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mercury MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercury provides these MCP tools: load_account, load_transaction, load_recipient, load_account_statement, and load_accounts_card.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mercury?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mercury in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Mercury requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mercury is developed by Mercury. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
